from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Captures the essential metadata of a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the document as written")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., '判决书', '裁定书')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) recorded in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
